invariants.rationale: The method always constructs a HoodieWriteMetadata instance and returns it, so result is never null.
The method always calls setWriteStatuses with HoodieListData.eager(writeStatusList); getWriteStatuses should never be null.
The method would NPE early if clusteringPlan were null, so this is a reasonable invariant at exit.
Method requires schema for clustering, and there are no safe guards for null, so schema should be non-null.
instantTime is required for clustering and always passed down; the method does not handle null values.
